gloss: to write, to publish, to author

definitions.explanation: To write and publish a book or work.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{多|おお}くの{論文|ろんぶん}を{著|あらわ}した。

notes:
{著|あらわ}す specifically means to write/publish works.

DISTINCTION:
- {著|あらわ}す: to author, publish (formal)
- {書|か}く: to write (general)
- {表|あらわ}す: to express, represent
